content_sections.heading: About UoH Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: The post is in a research project run in the Department of Biochemistry, School of Life Sciences, University of Hyderabad, Hyderabad. The Project Investigator is Dr. Anusree Lakshmi Sivadas, DST-INSPIRE Faculty Fellow, Department of Biochemistry. The project studies nuclear organization and its influence on gene expression and nuclear RNA surveillance in the yeast Schizosaccharomyces pombe.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply for the UoH Project Associate-I post. Any one of the following, from a recognized University or equivalent: Four years Bachelor's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences Masters degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences BVSc / B.Pharm Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship or GATE or any other National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments, Agencies or Institutions. This is desirable, not essential. Any experience in R&D in Academic and Industrial Institutions or Science and Technology organizations will be beneficial. The notice does not make experience compulsory. The age limit printed for the post is 32. The notice gives no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Project Associate-I post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Fellowship / honorarium: Rs. 37,000 per month. HRA: Rs. 11,100 per month, if applicable. Tenure: 1 year, extendable based on performance and/or grant availability. The appointment is purely temporary, and the appointee has no right to claim any regular appointment in the University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoH Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Write the application on plain paper or in the format named in the notice as Form B. Attach self-attested copies of all certificates that support the information given in the application. Send the application with the essential attachments by email to [email protected] . Make sure the application is received by 30 November 2026, the last date for receipt of filled-in applications. The notice does not mention an email subject line or a CV format. Application on plain paper or in Form B Self-attested copies of all certificates in support of the information furnished in the application

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to a written test / skill test and says no TA/DA will be paid for attending it. Only eligible candidates will be informed by e-mail / letter at a later date, and only selected candidates will be contacted. The notice does not give a date or venue for the test.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UoH Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Project Associate-I position in the Department of Biochemistry, School of Life Sciences, University of Hyderabad.

faq.answer: A four-year Bachelor's or a Master's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, BVSc, B.Pharm, or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent.
